output.diagnosis: Adding lru_cache changes the decorators, which must stay identical; it would also hand every caller the same mutable list. Dropped the cache, kept the sieve.
output.rationale: Marks composites in a list of booleans up to isqrt(limit) and collects the unmarked numbers in increasing order: the same primes, in O(n log log n) instead of O(n·π(n)).
